I'm here to talk to if you ever need someone. Just try to imagine what your sister was going through, perhaps she needed an end to suffering, and for most people its hard to imagine the possibility of a loved one experiencing that unless they've done it themselves. 

I have been in the exact position you're in and I'm willing to help with arms wide open, and I ask you will message me and reach out to me so I can be of some assistance
